summary.zh: 把化验单上的一个疑问拍成一百秒竖版微缩片，画面全由代码绘制。第 2 期从 3 分 57 秒砍到 1 分 40 秒，靠删知识点，不靠加速。
summary.en: One lab-sheet question becomes a 100-second paper-cut film, every frame drawn in code. Episode 2 went from 3:57 to 1:40 by dropping points, not speeding up.
